text:
elaine: Quick sync — we need final alignment on the pricing page experiment we want to push with the launch post tomorrow. main asks: updated FAQ copy, tier naming decision, calculator UX tweak, and inbound routing for demo leads.

mike: timeline check — launch post going live 9am PT tomorrow? cc @gwen for L2 QA and @samir for tier copy.

gwen: 9am PT works if I get final faq bullets by EOD today. can we keep answers short (one-liners) + link to playbook? :+1:

samir: throwing two naming options into the ring for A/B: Option A: "Launch / Momentum / Atlas" (clear product progression) Option B: "Core / Scale / Enterprise" (more conventional). lean A for distinctiveness.

anya: prefer names that map to features on hover. if we go with "Launch / Momentum / Atlas" i'll add hover copy: "Launch — dev-friendly hosted tier", "Momentum — reserved capacity for scale", "Atlas — private deployments & enterprise controls".

mike: agree with A. we need to validate against seo keywords — i'll run quick keyword check and post results in channel in 30m.

marc: calculator note — users were confused about committed vs monthly on the slab calc. propose toggles (Monthly vs Committed) and a small inline example: "Committed 20% off after 12mo" with summary row that shows effective unit price. also add a tooltip on overage thresholds.

elaine: good. can the calc show a traffic band highlight? e.g., if they enter 5M tokens, highlight nearest slab and effective savings.

marc: yes, dev already implemented a quick banding logic. snippet for the frontend team:
```
// slab banding pseudo
const bands = [ {limit:100_000, price:0.0008}, {limit:1_000_000, price:0.0006}, {limit:10_000_000, price:0.00045} ];
function pickBand(tokens){ return bands.find(b => tokens <= b.limit) || bands[bands.length-1]; }
```

gwen: FAQ drafts — keeping to single-sentence answers. first three Qs i pushed: "How does committed pricing work?" "What happens if we exceed committed capacity?" "Can I pin a model version?" will paste shortly.

samir: can we also add a tiny benchmark blurb under the pricing header: "Typical latency (p95) on Hosted API: 180–250ms; token cost per 1k tokens: $0.40 (example model)." helps set expectations. keep it non-technical.

mike: i ran keyword check: "LLM pricing", "inference cost", "dedicated gpu pricing" have good volume. add "inference pricing" into h2 or intro.

webinar-bot: Reminder — Pricing webinar scheduled in 3 days (Wed 10am PT). Presenters: @elaine, @samir. Slides due TUESDAY COB.

elaine: will take the positioning slide + launch post copy. samir — can you cover the technical differentiators and the cost/playbook slide?

samir: yep. i'll produce a one-slide benchmark narrative: 1) typical latency/cost tradeoffs, 2) fallback & reliability story, 3) how batching/caching reduces unit costs.

anya: inbound routing: for leads coming from the pricing page calculator, can we tag them as "pricing-calc" and route to SDR queue B (pricing-specialists)? also want a small survey modal: "Are you evaluating enterprise or startup use?" (2 choices).

mike: routing ok. @sales — FYI anyone who gets routed with "pricing-calc" should get the IQL tag. (will open a ticket to wire up).

gwen: copy for the launch post hero (first draft): "Predictable inference costs. Flexible deployments. One API." short subhead: "Hosted, Dedicated, Private — pick what fits your SLOs." feedback?

samir: love it. add parenthetical on the hero or directly under: "See sample latency & cost figures below" so folks scroll to the benchmark blurb.

elaine: decisions so far: Tier names = Launch/Momentum/Atlas; Calculator toggles = Monthly/Committed + band highlight; FAQ = one-liners (gwen to finalize); Inbound routing = pricing-calc -> SDR queue B; Webinar slides due TUESDAY COB.

mike: i'll draft the launch post and ping for approvals in the morning. can we do a quick 20 min sync at 8:15am PT to sign off?

gwen: 8:15 works. i'll bring final FAQ and updated CTA phrasing.

samir: i'll bring the benchmark slide + tier feature mapping.

anya: i'll validate the calc UI on staging and leave comments. planning to enable the survey modal for a 2-day experiment post-launch.

elaine: perfect. one last ask — include an example snippet for customers: "How to request a dedicated demo" with prefilled subject line. tiny UX win.

marc: adding a micro-copy suggestion for the demo CTA: "Request a demo — include your monthly token estimate". keeps SDRs aligned.

elaine: thanks everyone — see you at 8:15. :rocket:
